evidentiary_basis: All 20 statements (CS-P03-001..006; CS-P04-001..014); register hash 417A35A3...; sources FE-001 (01D5BDB1...) and FE-003 (62AFB4DD...); wider-text consultations recorded in the log (Art 9; Art 10; Annex III; Annex IV 3.3/4.3 lines; Art 12(5); 13; 14; 15; 22; 23)
what_was_done: Fixed object (formal legal text of two instruments, as frozen), jurisdiction (EU law), version (the OJ versions named in the register), time (acquisition 2026-09-30; no later amendments considered), problem (how the 20 statements allocate notification, verification, appointment, selection, escrow and complaint-routing work) and boundary (20 statements only; P04 Art 22(7) excluded; no regime). Verified that each frozen excerpt occurs in the official text; counted occurrences.
output_artifacts: Delimitation statement in CLAUDE_TRACK_B_ARCHITECTURAL_INFERENCES.md (scale and boundary) and EXECUTION_LOG; uncertainty U-07, U-10, U-28
concrete_contribution: Made the scale of every later claim explicit: it is a claim about 20 selected statements, not about either instrument (container fallacy blocked up front). The occurrence count showed that CS-P03-004, -005 and -006 appear verbatim twice (Annex III and Annex IV), so the Annex III anchor is a register choice, not a textual one (U-07). It also surfaced that several excerpts are truncated sentences (U-10, U-28), which fixes what can and cannot be evaluated.
risk_or_cost_observed: Partly redundant with the register's own provenance fields and with the delimitation already frozen; the 'problem' statement is the analyst's formulation and is itself an interpretive choice.
effort_note: Low to moderate: one pass; hash and excerpt-occurrence checks scripted. No per-operation timing was recorded.

evidentiary_basis: All 20 statements; segmentation_rationale and explicit_condition fields; Art 14, Art 15(1), Annex III 4.3 wider wording for context
what_was_done: Re-examined each statement's subject, modality, action, object, condition and context; kept the 20-statement segmentation unchanged (no split, no merge); listed actor mentions that sit inside conditions or object clauses (e.g., 'after consulting the Commission', 'designating the Commission as the beneficiary', 'chosen by the complainant', 'indicated by the Registry', 'which they have designated', 'at the expense of the Registry') as candidate-relation sources; recorded actor_expression for each statement.
output_artifacts: CLAUDE_TRACK_B_CODING.csv (modality, direct_text_elements, inferred_elements); list of condition-embedded actor mentions feeding O3
concrete_contribution: No statement was split or merged. The contribution was a bookkeeping list: six condition-embedded actor mentions were separated from the operative actions so O3 could decide each on its own (three accepted as thin relations: consultation, beneficiary designation, complainant choice; two deferred: designation presupposed, indication of the agent; one rejected: cost-bearing without payee).
risk_or_cost_observed: Largely re-validates the frozen segmentation; limited independent value beyond the condition-embedded list. Over-segmentation risk at relation level was handled in O3/O8 rather than here.

evidentiary_basis: All 20 statements; 32 candidate relationships R-P03-01..07, R-P04-01..25 (19 ACCEPTED, 5 DEFERRED, 8 REJECTED)
what_was_done: For each statement, tested parties (expressed or by stated cross-reference), direction, modality, condition and governance-relevant action. Typed each accepted relation (information, verification, appointment/selection, control, contractual, beneficiary, approval, participation). Recorded rejected and deferred candidates with reasons. Refused to supply unexpressed actors (CS-P03-004, CS-P04-012). Assessed authority, discretion and accountability per relation with 'not coded' where text does not support a level.
concrete_contribution: Blocked eight candidates that a graph of shared actors or a loose reading would have produced: Commission oversight of notified bodies (receipt of notification), Member States to manufacturer (transitive), generic Commission supervision of the Registry, Registry accountability to the Commission (report only), Registry-to-auditor cost relation (no payee), audit of validation agents (shared context), escrow agent to Commission (no action stated), Registry supervision of ADR providers (selection is not supervision). Deferred five (designation presupposed; decision notification with unexpressed notifier; indication of validation agent; submission of complaints; delegation of decision authority). One statement (CS-P03-003) stayed an assignment.
risk_or_cost_observed: The rule 'parties expressed' forced judgment calls on condition-embedded links (R-P04-03, -13, -16) that could reasonably be coded either way: false precision risk. Splitting by relation type produced 32 candidates for 20 statements, partly redundant.
effort_note: Highest of the eight operations: every statement adjudicated against candidates, with typed attributes. Roughly half of total analytic effort (qualitative estimate).

evidentiary_basis: R-P03-02, R-P03-03; R-P04-01..03, -05..08, -10..16, -18, -19; statements across anchors P04_PR02, PR03, PR04; considered-and-declined groupings X-P03-1, X-P03-2, X-P04-1..4
what_was_done: Grouped accepted relations by procedure/stage/instrument with explicit membership criteria (shared problem, qualified coupling by textual precedence, instrument, or stated cross-reference), not by shared actor or article. Produced five candidate configurations and six declined groupings, each with what is not established.
concrete_contribution: Grouped the three register anchors P04_PR02 (Art 13), P04_PR03 and P04_PR04 (Art 14) into one validation configuration (C-P04-A) because the relations are coupled by explicit precedence conditions; grouped Art 12(5) statements across the anchor boundary only for the audit; declined to group by the shared actor 'Registry' (X-P04-1) and declined 'a notification system' for the single Member State notification relation (X-P03-1).
risk_or_cost_observed: Membership criteria are the analyst's choice; configurations here are thin, and the labelled patterns (third-party verification, audit with reporting, escrow arrangement, complaint routing) risk being read as architecture-level labels. Mitigated by 'not established' lists.
effort_note: Moderate: justification text per configuration is long relative to the thin result.

evidentiary_basis: C-P03-A, C-P04-A..D; modality and condition fields of CS-P03-003..006 and CS-P04-001..014
what_was_done: For each configuration separated explicit order markers ('after consulting', 'before it is concluded', 'at the end of', 'as soon as', 'before the deadline'), entailed order (not stated), option (may; choice from a list), obligatoriness (shall/must), substitutability and conditional authority; marked every point where text gives no basis.
concrete_contribution: Distinguished stated precedence from entailed order (e.g., submission -> examination -> notification is textual in C-P04-A; agreement -> deposit in C-P04-C is only entailed), consultation (CS-P04-002) from consent (CS-P04-010), and a permissive power (CS-P04-014 'may') on which a later choice depends (CS-P04-012). Gateway and substitutability claims were refused for all configurations because no statement states a consequence of the step.
risk_or_cost_observed: The positional vocabulary (gateway, option, substitutability) can look informative while the answer is mostly 'not stated'; risk of over-reading entailed order as sequence.
effort_note: Moderate: one table per configuration; many cells are 'not supported'.

evidentiary_basis: Every property claim in CODING, RELATIONSHIPS, CONFIGURATIONS, POSITIONAL (46 claims logged)
what_was_done: Assigned a bearer (actor / relation / position / configuration / law / regime) and a boundary to each property claimed; listed refused lifts.
concrete_contribution: Refused 14 lifts, for example: Registry's selection power to a Registry-centred configuration or hub; 'independence' from the word 'independent' to the auditor or the audit configuration; Commission consent to a gateway for the Registry's operations; Annex III verification to Art 9 procedures as a whole; information duties to accountability; any property of a configuration to either instrument.
risk_or_cost_observed: Largely re-expresses the V8 cross-level error list (atomistic, ecological, container fallacies) on this dataset; the added step is the explicit bearer column. Risk of redundancy with O7 declines.

evidentiary_basis: All configuration-level claims CL-P03-02, CL-P04-01..04; candidate architecture-level claims AC-P03-1, AC-P04-1..3; stopping decisions per case
what_was_done: Declared evidence, warrant, counter-evidence, alternatives and boundary limitations for each configuration-level claim; tested four candidate architecture-level claims against problem/scale, qualified coupling, consequence/bearer and significance factors; made explicit stopping decisions; built traceability chains to provision and source hash; made no regime-boundary decision.
concrete_contribution: none beyond consolidating the stopping decisions already implied by the O3-O6 results: no architecture-level claim was warranted before or after this step. It produced the traceability chains and the declined-claim register, which restate rather than change earlier decisions.
risk_or_cost_observed: Redundant with V8's own stopping rule and traceability requirement; length without change in the result (verbosity risk; a short 'stop at configuration' would have carried the same decision).
effort_note: Moderate to high in writing effort; no new decision.

what_was_done: Tested twelve alternative cuts or readings (segmentation split/merge; unexpressed actors resolved by context; designation accepted; grammatical subject not an actor; condition-embedded relations removed; consent readings; adverbial attachment; Annex IV equivalence; hub removal; configuration merges across Registry and phased-registration lines) and recorded effects on relations, configurations and inferences.
concrete_contribution: Showed which claims depend on a single reading: R-P04-01 and C-P04-B's Commission-facing link depend on identifying 'independent audit' with the auditor; the Member State-to-notified body chain depends on the deferred designation relation; C-P04-C keeps its core if the thin beneficiary relation is removed; no tested reading raised any claim to architecture level. Flagged nine relations for human review.
risk_or_cost_observed: Many tested alternatives left claim levels unchanged: partial redundancy. The choice of which alternatives to test is itself analyst-selected (selection bias in sensitivity).
effort_note: Moderate: twelve cuts; effects traced by hand.
